correctness.rationale: The finite claim is reconstructed from the definitions. The verifier generates all 72 admissible words and 1168 edges, exhaustively lists every maximal clique, independently re-enumerates every six-clique, and checks all distance and subgroup-orbit assertions for every maximum. The two enumeration paths agree on exactly 512 six-cliques and no maximal clique exceeds six.

value.rationale: The parameter is a canonical exact entry in the foundational constant-GC reverse-complement DNA-code table. Classifying all equality cases reveals a universal perfect-matching rigidity and 14 symmetry types, information not supplied by the known optimum alone and useful as a benchmark for construction and symmetry questions in constrained DNA coding.
